name: r4-q4-route-blob-tz-linked
description: Fix Q4 (review A2 B2): on a linked gateway trg_sync_valve_schedules_outbox_ai builds json_object(..., 'timezone', NEW.timezone), which throws on a BLOB. A schedule created for a valve whose zone timezone is a BLOB is bound as that BLOB, so the INSERT fails and nothing is queued; a backend that binds the gateway text instead writes the schedule, an outbox row and a plan push. C1 X'', C3 BLOB 'Asia/Tokyo'; C2 empty TEXT is the control. The zones are seeded before the link, since the zone trigger refuses them too. C2's creates emit VALVE_RUNTIME_CHANGED: its recent_stale_state is a BLOB 'STALE_NO_OBSERVATION' (store.js recentStaleState's LIKE matches a BLOB as text and answers the Buffer), and before the east create its pushes fail with a BLOB 'stale_unconfirmed', which isLostRow does not count as lost. West gateway Etc/GMT+12, then east Pacific/Kiritimati.
